projects.title: NYC Comptroller Storefront Vacancy Dashboard
projects.description: A new dashboard from the Comptroller's office tracks storefront vacancies, openings and closings citywide and by borough and neighborhood, using Live XYZ street-survey data and updated quarterly. As of the third quarter of 2026 it counts 16,047 vacant storefronts out of 141,744, a rate of 11.32%.
projects.why_interesting: Neighborhood retail health can now be checked quarter by quarter; the release flags five neighborhoods at or near 20% vacancy.

projects.title: NYC future floodplain and high-tide layers, 2030s to 2150s
projects.description: City Planning map layers on NYC Open Data show projected coastal-storm floodplains, with a companion set for high tides, using 90th percentile sea level rise projections from the fourth New York City Panel on Climate Change. The portal dates publication to Oct. 8, 2026; BetaNYC listed them as new on Nov. 19.
projects.why_interesting: Downloadable geography for showing which blocks, buildings and public facilities fall inside projected flooding, decade by decade.

projects.title: Small SF
projects.description: An illustrated, zoomable map of San Francisco by Ari Dutilh, redrawn from 3D imagery with an image model, with live transit, boats, planes and weather layered on top. The cars, including Waymos, are simulated.
projects.why_interesting: A model for making live city feeds feel like a place. The About page spells out which layers are live and which are simulated.

projects.title: StreetPulse: AI ratings of street-level appeal
projects.description: Interactive 2D and 3D maps, including one of New York, in which AI scores street images on measures such as beauty, perceived safety and pedestrian-friendly design. It comes from researchers tied to Corvinus University of Budapest and the Toulouse School of Economics, and was covered by Euronews on Nov. 26.
projects.why_interesting: A block-level perception layer to test against what New Yorkers know about their own streets. These are model judgments of street photos and should be read that way.

projects.title: roughMaps
projects.description: A free, open-source browser tool that redraws any place in 55 hand-drawn styles using OpenStreetMap data, with print sizes up to 24 by 36 inches.
projects.why_interesting: A quick way to make a distinctive neighborhood locator map without design software.

projects.title: Iowa City Affordable Housing Dashboard
projects.description: Brings together the local housing market, residential development, income-restricted units, city housing assistance, housing authority data and the homeless response system, drawing on Census data, city records, nonprofits and state agencies.
projects.why_interesting: Putting market supply, subsidized units and homelessness on one dashboard is a structure larger cities could copy.

projects.title: Atlas of Government Design Systems
projects.description: A community-maintained map and directory of national, regional and municipal government design systems, noting source code, technology and accessibility status. BetaNYC listed it on Nov. 19.
projects.why_interesting: A reference for comparing how New York's government web design and accessibility standards stack up against other places.

projects.title: BetaNYC NYPD Weekly Archive
projects.description: Saves the NYPD's weekly TrafficStat, CompStat, traffic fatality and related files before nyc.gov overwrites them, and publishes them as tidy CSVs, including precinct-level numbers. The repository was updated this week.
projects.why_interesting: BetaNYC says the City does not keep these weekly figures available once they are replaced, so the archive makes week-by-week precinct trends possible to check.

projects.title: BetaNYC New York data registry MCP server
projects.description: Lets AI assistants search for open datasets across the New York portals in BetaNYC's registry. It searches a metadata index, not the data itself. The repository was updated this week.
projects.why_interesting: Helps reporters find which city, county or state portal holds a dataset before they start querying.
